mcqs.question: What date did the Julian calendar begin?
mcqs.explanation: The Julian calendar began on 1 January in 45 BC.
mcqs.source_text: The year used in dates during the Roman Republic and the Roman Empire was the consular year, which began on the day when consuls first entered office—probably 1 May before 222 BC, 15 March from 222 BC and 1 January from 153 BC. mcqs.question: What is the primary function of certain substances in the atmosphere that absorb and re-radiate infrared radiation from the sun?

To absorb and re-emit visible radiation from the sun
To keep the atmosphere and surface much warmer than if they were absent from the atmosphere

mcqs.source_text: Earth's surface and the clouds absorb visible and invisible radiation from the sun and re-emit much of the energy as infrared back to atmosphere. mcqs.question: Why can cracks in the upper part of a glacier form deep crevasses?
options: Because of differences in glacier velocity in the upper and lower sections.
Because the upper part is too cold and rigid.
mcqs.explanation: According to the document, crevasses form due to differences in glacier velocity between rigid sections.
mcqs.source_text: The top 50 m (160 ft) of a glacier are rigid because they are under low pressure. This upper section is known as the fracture zone and moves mostly as a single unit over the plastically flowing lower section. When a glacier moves through irregular terrain, cracks called crevasses develop in the fracture zone. Crevasses form due to differences in glacier velocity. mcqs.explanation: In Dutch, the diminutive form of "groen" is indeed "groentje", as stated in the document.
mcqs.source_text: In Dutch, the diminutive is not merely restricted to nouns and exist in numerals (met z'n tweetjes, "the two of us"), pronouns (onderonsje, "tête-à-tête"), verbal particles (moetje, "shotgun marriage"), and even prepositions (toetje, "dessert").
